Joins Montgomery tracts to 2026 code-violation counts and CDC high-blood-pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, keeps only paired tracts, and returns the correlation and paired-tract count as window statistics ranked by violation rate.
sql:
WITH code_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_5e4647' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
cdc AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_5e4647_m2_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         CASE WHEN cc.violations IS NOT NULL AND c.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND c.totalpopulation > 0
              THEN cc.violations / c.totalpopulation * 1000 END AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
         c.high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN code_counts cc ON cc.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN cdc c ON c.geoid = t.geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM base
  WHERE code_violations_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL AND high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name,
       code_violations_per_1000_residents,
       high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
       CORR(code_violations_per_1000_residents, high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS corr_code_violations_high_blood_pressure,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 200
